name: @fg/db
description: Esquema PostgreSQL, semilla y pruebas de BD. Migraciones en SQL plano.

scripts.migrate: for f in migrations/*.sql; do psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.reset: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -q -c 'drop schema public cascade; create schema public;' && pnpm migrate && pnpm seed
